subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a supported JSON-RPC child-process plugin ABI for language-agnostic plugins, and if so should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 be the protocol-v1 implementation path?
rationale: This adds a public SDK/manifest contract and child-process trust boundary that automation cannot choose safely without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Accept protocol-v1 via linked PR
options.body: Review the linked PR's ABI, permission model, lifecycle behavior, docs, and validation, then land it if the support boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Narrow or gate the ABI
options.body: Keep the issue open but require the PR to reduce supported registrations or mark the bridge experimental/internal before release.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the issue as a design record and close or pause the PR if maintainers are not ready to own a language-neutral plugin process ABI.

recommendation.title: Accept protocol-v1 via linked PR
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR's ABI, permission model, lifecycle behavior, docs, and validation, then land it if the support boundary is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the companion implementation PR and wrote the feature request, making them the best first owner to coordinate the maintainer decision.
